In this video, we dive into the process of calculating job run costs using SQL in Databricks. Instead of tedious manual calculations based on cluster configurations, Databricks provides a streamlined solution by leveraging system tables that log all necessary information. Understanding job costs is crucial for performance optimization and helps in assessing the expenses associated with long-running jobs.
